component.name: Cloud Clipboard
component.summary: Copy new files from a cloud folder to the clipboard

description.p: Watches a folder on any cloud storage rclone supports (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox…) or on this computer. Every new file goes to the clipboard and then moves to an archive subfolder, where it's deleted after a day. Scan a document on the phone, press Ctrl+V on the computer.
A tray icon pauses and resumes watching and opens the settings.
